steps.description: Checks if the UID of a data source is valid.
steps.resolution: Check the documentation for more information or delete the data source and create a new one.
steps.title: UID validation

steps.description: Checks if a data source is healthy.
steps.resolution: Go to the data source configuration page and address the issues reported.
steps.title: Health check

steps.description: Checks if the plugin associated with the data source is installed and available.
steps.resolution: Delete the datasource or install the plugin.
steps.title: Missing plugin check

steps.description: Checks if Prometheus data sources are using deprecated authentication methods (Azure auth and SigV4)
steps.resolution: Make sure that 'Azure Monitor Managed Service for Prometheus' and/or 'Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus' plugins are installed. If the data source is provisioned, edit data source type in the provisioning file to use 'grafana-amazonprometheus-datasource' or 'grafana-azureprometheus-datasource'.
steps.title: Prometheus deprecated authentication check
